card.reprocessFailed: Re-recognition did not work; your earlier sentences are still here: {{reason}}

confirmDelete.title: Delete this item?
confirmDelete.body: The media and its sentences are removed. Your recordings and scores stay in your history.

catalog.empty: Featured items are on the way
catalog.emptyHint: They will appear here once the administrator publishes them.
catalog.deleteCopyBody: This only removes your copy. The featured original stays and you can add it again later. Sentence scores and progress on this copy are deleted too, so adding it again starts fresh; your recordings and assessments stay in your practice history.

confirmRebuild.title: Re-split this item's sentences?
confirmRebuild.body: The sentences are cut again from the existing recognition with the latest method. This uses no transcription allowance. Your edits to sentence text and times are replaced; sentences whose text did not change keep their translations.

confirmReprocess.title: Re-recognize this item?
confirmReprocess.body: The whole audio is transcribed again and uses today's transcription allowance once more. Your edits to sentence text and times, and any translations, are replaced. The item cannot be opened while it runs; if it fails, your current sentences are kept.
